statusLegend.published: Listing is publicly visible and was observed directly.
statusLegend.submitted: Filed and awaiting review. Not yet publicly visible.

directories.name: Anthropic claude-community
directories.submission: web form; requires a signed-in Claude account
directories.notes: Pull requests against anthropics/claude-plugins-community are closed automatically; that repository is a read-only nightly mirror of the internal review pipeline. Approved plugins install with the @claude-community suffix.

review.outcome: not approved: a reviewer asked for changes
review.blocking: A package ran without an exact version in skill text (skills/develop-with-singapore-mcp: `npx -y @olano/mcp-singapore`, `npx @olano/sg-cli`). Launchers were already pinned.
fixes: Pinned both commands to @0.4.1 in the skill and its plugin copy; bump-version.mjs now rewrites the pins and check-claude-plugins.mjs fails on any unpinned or stale @olano invocation in skill text.
Added icon (./assets/olano-singapore.svg, 512x512 viewBox) to all seven plugin.json files; validator pin moved to @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.289, which recognises the field.
review.open: Reviewer's non-blocking finding to bundle the package code into the plugin as readable source under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT (<=256 KB per file, <=512 files) is not done: compiled dist is about 1.2 MB before runtime dependencies. Needs its own build step.
review.next: Resubmit from the same repository and folder; the review reads the latest commit.

directories.name: Glama
directories.submission: automatic discovery; publishers may claim the listing
directories.notes: Previously recorded as indexed. Could not be confirmed from the release environment because glama.ai is unreachable through the egress proxy. Confirm from a normal browser and, if it resolves, claim the server and set the status to published with the observed date.

directories.name: Docker MCP Catalog
directories.notes: Generate the manifest with the repository's task wizard. The existing Dockerfile is already built and smoke-tested in CI, so the containerised path is viable. On approval Docker builds and signs the image and the catalog entry appears within about 24 hours.

directories.name: OpenAI Plugins Directory
directories.submission: upload a skills-only bundle with review metadata
directories.notes: Public listings must omit the local stdio MCP configuration and ship only the focused skill directories.

directories.name: Smithery
directories.submission: publish a public Streamable HTTP endpoint or an MCPB bundle
directories.blocker: No public HTTPS MCP endpoint and no MCPB artifact is built today. The server supports Streamable HTTP, but nothing is hosted, and PRIVACY.md states no Olano-hosted endpoint exists.
